assessment_origin: LLM-assisted researcher-facing technical assessment; not independent human review and not an approval decision
reference_frameworks: Zeller et al. The Fuzzing Book
Chen et al. 2018 Metamorphic Testing review
Klees et al. 2018 Evaluating Fuzz Testing
safety_and_rigor_gates: Research owner independently signs versioned scope declaration; this addendum never substitutes for authorization
Confirm valid bounded domains and input/output serialization for each task before generation
Implement each trusted oracle by two algorithmically distinct methods; reconcile all disagreement before using labels
Run trusted oracle self-tests and reviewed metamorphic invariants before using any candidate outputs
Freeze development challenge inputs before candidate evaluation and audit their SHA256
Execute generated candidate code only inside existing hardened pinned Docker image; never host Python exec/import
Keep validation, heldout and temporal_pending tasks inaccessible during iterative development
Record method budgets including token cost, calls, executions, and time; do not equate equal test count with equal compute
Label failures only when oracle agreement and a reproducible Docker counterexample exist; keep ambiguous cases unresolved
Keep self-review limitations explicit; later independent reviewer would strengthen publication claims but is not a prerequisite for exploratory development

technical_assessment.caveat: For larger N or k, the brute-force checker is impractical; use bounded audit and prove greedy choice for the permitted domain.
technical_assessment.domain: N=2..4 square grids containing each integer 1..N*N once; k=1..8; valid cardinality and adjacency only
metamorphic: Every output has exactly k values
Adjacent output values map to edge-neighbor grid cells
Output begins with the grid minimum (1)
technical_assessment.oracle_a: Lexicographically greedy path: start with unique 1; repeatedly choose the smallest valued in-bounds neighbor; revisit allowed.
technical_assessment.oracle_b: Exhaustively enumerate adjacent paths for N<=3 and k<=7, take lexicographically minimal value sequence; cross-check oracle A.

boundary: nested subsequence despite malformed whole input
technical_assessment.caveat: The word subsequence (rather than substring) is decisive. Lock the precise interpretation using prompt examples before candidate generation; do not silently reinterpret malformed inputs.
technical_assessment.domain: Strings over characters [ and ] only, lengths 0..20; no other characters.
metamorphic: Appending brackets cannot destroy an existing [ [] ] subsequence witness
Strings with fewer than 2 opens or 2 closes are false
technical_assessment.oracle_a: Subsequence witness: true iff there exist positions i<j<k<l with characters [,[,],] respectively.
technical_assessment.oracle_b: For lengths <=12 enumerate all index subsequences, accept if a balanced subsequence contains depth >=2; compare to witness oracle.

technical_assessment.caveat: Meaning of word I in contractions and extra punctuation is not explicitly defined; exclude these until contract review.
technical_assessment.domain: ASCII alphabetic words separated by spaces; sentence delimiters . ? !; no contractions, quotes, comma prefixes or other punctuation in initial development suite.
metamorphic: Concatenating a non-I-starting sentence with a delimiter preserves prior count
Appending an I-starting sentence after a delimiter increases count by one
technical_assessment.oracle_a: Split on .?! then strip leading whitespace; count segments whose first space-separated word is exactly uppercase I.
technical_assessment.oracle_b: Independent finite-state tokenizer that marks sentence start and accumulates words; compare on bounded strings.

boundary: large values relative to list length
technical_assessment.caveat: Do not extend to negative or zero values; task promises positive integers.
technical_assessment.domain: Nonempty lists of positive integers; lengths 1..60; values 1..100.
metamorphic: Input permutation does not change answer
Duplicating all elements cannot make a previously qualifying value disqualify
technical_assessment.oracle_a: Frequency map; choose max v>0 where count(v)>=v or -1.
technical_assessment.oracle_b: For every distinct value v count occurrences by independent scanning loop; choose maximum satisfying threshold.

technical_assessment.caveat: Standard definition treats empty string as palindrome; explicitly audit against spec examples if any new interpretation arises.
technical_assessment.domain: ASCII alphabetic s and c strings of lengths 0..80; case sensitive.
metamorphic: Permuting c does not change the answer
Adding to c a character absent from s does not change the answer
technical_assessment.oracle_a: Filter s by character membership in set(c); compare filtered result to its reversal.
technical_assessment.oracle_b: Repeatedly remove each character in c from s via independent string replacement; use two-pointer palindrome check.

technical_assessment.caveat: Second smallest is second DISTINCT smallest, as demonstrated by [1,1] -> None.
metamorphic: Reordering list preserves result
Duplicating any existing value preserves result
technical_assessment.oracle_a: Return sorted(set(lst))[1] if >=2 distinct values, else None.
technical_assessment.oracle_b: Single pass track smallest and second distinct smallest; no sets or sorting.

technical_assessment.caveat: Exclude repeated whitespace and multi-character tokens until an explicit expanded domain is reviewed.
technical_assessment.domain: Empty string, or one-character lowercase a-z tokens separated by one ASCII space; 1..80 tokens.
metamorphic: Token permutation does not change frequency mapping
Duplicating every token doubles each returned maximum count
technical_assessment.oracle_a: Count tokens with a frequency map; return all entries tied at maximum; empty -> {}.
technical_assessment.oracle_b: For each unique token count exact token matches by scanning split input; collect all argmax counts.

technical_assessment.caveat: Return exact list contents and preserve first-argument tie convention.
technical_assessment.domain: Two lists of ASCII strings, each length 0..20; each string length 0..40.
metamorphic: Permuting strings within either list preserves which argument is returned
Replacing strings with equal-length strings preserves choice
technical_assessment.oracle_a: Compare sum(map(len,lst1)) and sum(map(len,lst2)); return first list on a tie.
technical_assessment.oracle_b: Independent loops accumulate character counts by iterating over individual strings and characters; select list with smaller total.

technical_assessment.caveat: Only eight official planet names are in the specified domain; do not accept aliases or case-normalize.
technical_assessment.domain: Valid names are exactly Mercury Venus Earth Mars Jupiter Saturn Uranus Neptune, plus selected invalid name strings; case sensitive.
metamorphic: Swapping endpoints leaves returned tuple unchanged
Output order always matches canonical solar order
technical_assessment.oracle_a: Index lookup in canonical planet order; return tuple of strictly intermediate names between the endpoints, sorted sun-outward.
technical_assessment.oracle_b: Iterate canonical planet list with numeric rank; select planets strictly between endpoint ranks; invalid -> empty tuple.

technical_assessment.caveat: Prompt does not establish behavior for noninteger n; exclude. A later review may extend integer n below zero.
technical_assessment.domain: Integer n=0..10000, integer x and y in -1000..1000.
metamorphic: Changing x cannot affect output when n composite
Changing y cannot affect output when n prime
technical_assessment.oracle_a: Integer trial division primality; return x iff n prime else y.
technical_assessment.oracle_b: Independent sieve of Eratosthenes table for n <=10000, with primes determined by sieve; choose x/y.
